page1.title: Welcome
page1.text:
To use Google Calendar, Gmail and Google Home with VASS, you need OAuth2 credentials.

STEP 1: Go to https://console.cloud.google.com
Sign in with your Google account.

STEP 2: Create or select a project
Click the dropdown menu at the top (near the Google Cloud logo) and select an existing project or click NEW PROJECT, give it a name (e.g. VASS).

STEP 3: Enable required APIs
Side menu → APIs & Services → Library
Search and enable ONE AT A TIME:
- Google Calendar API
- Gmail API
- Google Assistant API

STEP 4: Configure OAuth consent screen
Side menu → APIs & Services → https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials/consent
- Choose External (external user)
- Fill in: App name (e.g. VASS), support email, developer email
- Save and continue (no extra scopes needed)

⚠️ IMPORTANT - Test users vs Publishing:
If you leave the app in Testing mode:
  • Go to the Audience section of the OAuth consent screen
  • Under Test users, click + ADD USERS
  • Enter YOUR email (e.g. youraddress@gmail.com)
  • Click SAVE
  • WARNING: in Testing mode the token expires after 7 days!

To avoid expiration, make the app PUBLIC:
  • On the OAuth consent screen page, click PUBLISH APP at the top
  • Confirm. The app is still only usable by you (not on a store)
  • The token will no longer expire

STEP 5: Create OAuth2 credentials
Side menu → APIs & Services → https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
Click + CREATE CREDENTIALS at the top → OAuth client ID
- Application type: Desktop application
- Name: VASS Desktop
- Click CREATE

STEP 6: Download the JSON file
In the popup window, click DOWNLOAD JSON
Save it in a folder you'll remember (e.g. Downloads)

STEP 7: Click Next to select the downloaded JSON file.

page5.title: Google Home (optional)
page5.info:
To control Google Home devices (broadcast, smart home, voice commands), you need to register a device model in the Google Actions Console.

WHAT IS THE ACTIONS CONSOLE
It is a separate console from Google Cloud. It tells Google Assistant that your VASS device is authorized to send commands.

STEP 1: Access the Actions Console
Open your browser: https://console.actions.google.com
Sign in with the SAME Google account used for the Cloud Console.

STEP 2: Create or select the project
Click 'New project' or select an existing project.
Current Project ID: {project_id}

STEP 3: Prepare the client_secret.json file
The file is needed to authorize CLI commands. If you still have the JSON downloaded from the Cloud Console, rename it to credentials/google_client_secret.json in the VASS folder.
If you no longer have the file, re-download it from the Cloud Console: APIs & Services -> Credentials -> click on your OAuth 2.0 Client ID -> DOWNLOAD JSON.

STEP 4: Open the terminal and create credentials

Windows:
  Start Menu, search for 'PowerShell' or 'Terminal'

macOS/Linux:
  Open Terminal (Spotlight -> Terminal / Ctrl+Alt+T)

Navigate to the VASS folder:
  cd C:\Users\yourname\Documents\Python\vass

Run (all on one line):
  google-oauthlib-tool --client-secrets credentials/google_client_secret.json --scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/assistant-sdk-prototype --save

The browser will open for authorization. After authorization, the credentials.json file is created automatically.

STEP 5: Register the device model
In the terminal, run (all on one line):
  googlesamples-assistant-devicetool --project-id {project_id} register-model --model vass-desktop --type LIGHT --trait action.devices.traits.OnOff --manufacturer VASS --product-name "VASS Assistant" --description "VASS voice assistant"

STEP 6: Register the device instance
Still in the terminal, run:
  googlesamples-assistant-devicetool --project-id {project_id} register-device --device vass-desktop-01 --model vass-desktop --nickname "VASS" --client-type SERVICE

If you get an error 'multiple values for keyword argument token', run this fix:
  On Windows:
    python -c "import json,os; p=os.path.expandvars(r'%APPDATA%\google-oauthlib-tool\credentials.json'); d=json.load(open(p)); d.pop('token',None); json.dump(d,open(p,'w'))"
  On macOS/Linux:
    python -c "import json,os; p=os.path.expanduser('~/.config/google-oauthlib-tool/credentials.json'); d=json.load(open(p)); d.pop('token',None); json.dump(d,open(p,'w'))"

STEP 7: Enter the data below
  Model ID:  vass-desktop
  Device ID: vass-desktop-01

If you don't have Google Home, check 'Skip'.
